column2: Fresh -cfgfile profile; Default_7.0.ReaperThemeZip; no custom keymap, mouse map, or third-party extensions
With only Track A selected, 40529 adding B1 and 40530 toggling B1 off both preserve selected_tracks=A while GetLastTouchedTrack changes A→B.

ReaScript GetSelectedMediaItem enumeration follows project item order (A1,A2,B1) after Add A2, even when the SetMediaItemSelected setup listed B1 before A1; it does not expose a separate primary active item.

Native multi-item Item Properties reports two takes selected and leaves the differing Take name field blank; no native primary-item identity is exposed by this probe, so AAADAW active-item parity remains open.
Two tracks; MIDI items A1/A2 and B1/B2 at 1-2, 4-5, 1-2, and 3-4 seconds
